verdict.rationale: SerpApi's per-engine API reference pages document parameters in detail and link to a playground billed as a "live and interactive demo" (e.g. /playground?engine=google). A script builder generates starter code, and runnable code samples appear in the GitHub client docs. Evidence of the playground's depth is thin: there is no hands-on or independent corroboration, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground's interactivity and coverage across all engines, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for tool-driven exploration, documented runnable examples embedded directly in each reference page.
